responsibility: Auxiliary C support for Interfaces.C.Streams and related Ada stream/file services. It exposes wrappers for feof/ferror/fileno, exports standard stdio constants and standard streams as callable functions, computes full path names in a target-dependent way, implements 64-bit ftell/fseek abstractions across hosts, and detects FIFO paths. Compared with cio.c, this file focuses on file-stream semantics, constants, and path resolution rather than character console I/O.
